aboutLead: ITwerf builds practical open tools for developers and small teams.
aboutP1: We care about software that is clear, usable, and easy to host. Devfolio started as our own need: a portfolio and project site that runs on GitHub Pages without a complicated build pipeline.
aboutP2: ITwerf is the organisation behind that work. We ship small frameworks, docs, and experiments that others can fork, theme, and make their own.
aboutP3: Want to use Devfolio for your site? Grab a release on the Download page, or clone the generic starter repo and follow the README.
downloadLead: Pre-release builds of the static starter. Pick a version, unzip, customise, push to GitHub Pages.
downloadHow2: Edit config/site.json with your name and links.
downloadHow3: Replace sample projects and posts under content/.
downloadHow4: Push to a GitHub repo and set Pages to Deploy from branch → main → / (root).
